ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is the University of Toronto's most prestigious undergraduate award, covering tuition, books, incidental fees and residence for four years. The process is nomination-based: schools must nominate by 9 October 2026, students apply for admission by 16 October 2026, and the scholarship application closes on 6 November 2026.

Programme Highlights

  • About 37 fully funded scholars selected each year across U of T's three campuses
  • Three-step timeline: school nomination (9 Oct), admission application (16 Oct), scholarship application (6 Nov 2026)
  • Only for first-entry undergraduate programmes, starting September 2027
  • Fraud notice: U of T works only through verified schools, never agents

Who Should Apply

International secondary-school students in their final year (or graduated no earlier than June 2026) requiring a Canadian study permit, nominated by their school as its top candidate.

Funding and Costs

Full tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years of undergraduate study (about 37 scholars per year).

Deadline and How to Apply

Secure your school's nomination first, submit the OUAC admission application by 16 October 2026, then complete the Pearson scholarship application by 6 November 2026. Key deadline information: 6 November 2026 (student scholarship application). School nomination deadline 9 October 2026; OUAC admission application 16 October 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Toronto

University of Toronto is a public research university in Ontario, Canada. It offers undergraduate, graduate and professional education across science, engineering, medicine, business, humanities and social sciences. Its campuses and research institutes support academic inquiry and international collaboration, connecting students and researchers with questions spanning scientific discovery and contemporary society.

Official website: https://www.utoronto.ca/

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 6 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
